blocks.text: MIAMI — Bam Adebayo finished with 37 points and 14 rebounds, Giannis Antetokounmpo also scored 37 and the Miami Heat took control of East Group B by beating the Cleveland Cavaliers 133-121 in an NBA Cup game Friday night. It was the second time the Heat had two players score 37 in the same game: LeBron James and Dwyane Wade did it in 2013. READ: NBA: Antetokounmpo, Klay Thompson lead Heat over struggling Kings Davion Mitchell had 22 points and a career-high-tying 17 assists for Miami, which won its third straight.
